name: Parking display wall case
description: Two-part FDM PETG wall case for the parking distance display board: front shell (transducer, OLED, stop-LED, power-LED and buzzer openings, bottom cable exit) and wall back plate (keyhole slots, PCB standoffs, HC-SR04 support posts, cable-tie bar). Joined by 4x M3x25 screws from the front.

front_inner_z.label: Front panel inner face height above board bottom

standoff_height.label: PCB standoff height (back plate to board bottom)

board_clearance.label: Board edge to inner wall clearance

hcsr04_back_z.label: HC-SR04 module PCB back face height above board bottom

oled_window_dy.label: OLED window centre offset from module centre (+Y = away from header)

show_reference.label: Show board and module reference bodies

assumptions.label: Board outline 64 x 66 mm, 1.62 mm thick, M3 holes at (+/-28, +/-29)
HC-SR04 module 45 x 20 mm PCB, ~15 mm total height, ~16 mm transducer cans on 26 mm centres
assumptions.source: SparkFun SEN-15569 product data (ds_2d01ab019f07b9d598f0); +/-2 mm build tolerance

assumptions.label: HC-SR04 back face = socket pin centreline z 2.89 + 1.27 mm
assumptions.source: mechanical/imports/parking-board.step occurrence bounds (socket body z 1.615-4.155); verify on the assembled board

assumptions.label: OLED on 8.5 mm female header: module back at z 10.1, glass front ~13.1
assumptions.source: Standard 2.54 mm female header 8.5 mm body; Adafruit 326 footprint glass outline 26.7 x 19.3 mm

assumptions.label: Window covers the 21.7 x 10.9 mm active area with margin; exact active-area offset not dimensioned by Adafruit
5 mm stop LED soldered with long leads so its dome seats in the front hole
Wall screws: 4 mm (#8) pan-head wood screws, head <= 8.5 mm dia, head left 3 mm proud of wall
4x M3x25 pan-head screws front-to-back, self-tapping into 2.6 mm PETG pilots; 4x M3x8 for the PCB
THT leads trimmed to <= 2.5 mm below board (5 mm standoffs)
assumptions.source: Assembly instruction; KiCad buzzer model shows untrimmed 15 mm leads

assumptions.label: Keyhole: 2.5 mm shank slot, 3 mm head pocket, 2.5 mm lip (8 mm plate)
assumptions.source: Chosen design value; case + board + modules ~150 g

checks.label: Board and module envelopes clear walls, columns and front panel
PETG FDM printability of both parts in their print orientation
